EXTENSION.JMCMODLIB.CONFIG.BetterSaveSlo: Configures the total save slot count. Re-enter the profile flow, or restart the game if needed, after changing it.
Imports normal profileN saves into matching modded/profileN slots. Existing MOD saves require confirmation before overwrite.
EXTENSION.BETTERSAVESLOTS.POPUP.COPY_EMP: Slot {Id} has no progress.save and cannot be used as the copy source.
EXTENSION.BETTERSAVESLOTS.POPUP.COPY_OVE:
Copy slot {Source} into slot {Target}?
[color=#ff8f8f]The target slot will be deleted and replaced.[/color]
EXTENSION.BETTERSAVESLOTS.POPUP.COPY_DON: Slot {Source} has been copied into slot {Target}.
EXTENSION.BETTERSAVESLOTS.POPUP.IMPORT_N: Normal saves can only be imported after the game is running with MOD save isolation enabled.
EXTENSION.BETTERSAVESLOTS.POPUP.IMPORT_O:
